item.title: Ask HN: How would u setup a child's first Linux computer?
item.description:
📝 By comparison on Linux if they search the local “app store” they’ll find stacks and stacks of free, useful, open licensed software. My kids loved the power, freedom and later unexpected community this bought them. Linux with free and open software is the goal and focus.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45864732
